---
title: "How to contribute"
description: "Suggest a paper, join the Zotero group, write for Commentary or report an error."
---

## Suggest a paper for the Library

Send the title or the DOI of a work on populism, and a line on why it belongs in the [Library](../library/index.qmd), to the editor: editor@populiverse.com

## Join the Zotero group

The Library lives in a public Zotero group called "PopuliVerse Library". Scholars who suggest papers regularly are invited to join it as editors.

## Write for Commentary

Commentary publishes pieces of 800 to 1,500 words in which scholars comment on populism and populist actors. They are written by PhD holders and doctoral candidates. See the [call and the guidelines](../commentary/index.qmd#call-for-commentary).

## Report an error or ask for a reply

If something published here is wrong, write to the editor. Corrections are made in the open, never silently. A person or party discussed in an issue may also ask for a short reply. Both are described in the [editorial policy](editorial-policy.qmd).

## Get in touch

Write to the editor: editor@populiverse.com
